title: Portfolio projects
description: Drawing sheets shown on projects.html, in this order. Sheets are numbered DWG P-01, P-02… by position.

slots.description: Hazard-taped "work in progress" slots shown after the projects (only when no tag filter is active). One line each saying what belongs there; remove once the content exists.

kind.description: Context in the sheet strip, e.g. "Work · DT IT" or "Side project".

summary.description: Problem → what you did, two sentences max. Work projects: role and outcome only.

tags.description: Tools, in order of use. Known tools get an icon; AWS, Azure, GCP and OTC show as patched tags. Also used for the filter.

period.description: Shown in the sheet foot after the revision, e.g. "2025 –" or "2023 – 2025".

revision.description: Drawing revision letter, bumped when the project changes substantially. Defaults to "A".

repository.description: Source repository URL. github.com and gitlab.com are detected automatically.

repositoryHost.description: Only needed for self-hosted instances, e.g. gitlab.example.com.

caseStudyUrl.description: Write-up link. Without any link the card says "Case study soon".

image.description: Screenshot path relative to public/, e.g. "projects/portfolio.png". Side projects only.
